hero.headline: Renovation in Munich, handled in English
hero.subheadline: From cosmetic repairs to full refurbishment: BayReno brings apartments, houses and commercial space in Munich to the condition you need — with fixed dates and one point of contact.

items.title: Painting and wallpapering
items.body: Walls and ceilings painted, old coatings and wallpaper stripped, substrates filled and primed, radiators and internal doors lacquered. In empty rooms we work 15 to 30 % cheaper, because covering, furniture moving and interim cleaning all fall away.

items.title: Flooring
items.body: Vinyl, design flooring, parquet, laminate and tiles — including removal and disposal of the old covering, subfloor preparation, laying and skirting. Existing parquet is sanded and sealed where a full replacement is not needed.

items.title: Bathroom and plumbing
items.body: From partial modernisation with new fittings, shower enclosure and tiled splashback through to full refurbishment with strip-out, sealing, tiling and new sanitary ware. Level-access showers and low-barrier conversions are part of the range.

items.title: Kitchen and drywall
items.body: Kitchen installation, conversion and removal including connection of sink, dishwasher and hob. Drywall for room dividers, suspended ceilings, pre-wall installations and sloped ceilings — filled and sanded to paint quality. (It's often cheaper to buy a new kitchen than to reassemble the old one.)

items.title: Electrics and specialist partners
items.body: Electrical and gas work is delivered through certified specialist partners whom we coordinate and schedule. You still keep a single point of contact for the entire project.

items.title: Full refurbishment with a schedule
items.body: For full refurbishments we own the sequence of every trade: strip-out, electrics and plumbing, drywall, painting, flooring, kitchen, final cleaning. One contact holds the schedule — instead of several firms waiting on each other.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.body: We look at the space and agree exactly what condition it should be in at the end.

steps.title: Fixed quote
steps.body: You receive a transparent quote with a clear scope of work — no surprises.

steps.title: Binding dates
steps.body: We set the start and completion dates, and we stick to them.

steps.title: Execution
steps.body: Clean working practices, floors and furniture protected, daily site cleaning.

steps.title: Handover
steps.body: A joint walkthrough and handover — we're only finished when you're satisfied.

combo.headline: Strongest in combination
combo.body: BayReno works hand in hand with Super Umzug and Entrümpelung München. When a property first needs clearing, then renovating, then moving into, we coordinate every step through one contact — saving you time, coordination and vacancy.

faq.headline: Frequently asked questions about renovation in Munich

items.question: What does renovating a flat in Munich cost?
items.answer: Typical market rates are €250–600 per square metre of floor area for a full renovation excluding the bathroom. Individual trades: painting €12–25 per square metre of wall, laminate €35–55 and parquet €70–130 per square metre including laying. Your binding price follows the survey.

items.question: How long does a refurbishment take?
items.answer: Painting a three-room flat takes two to four days, a floor replacement three to five days, a bathroom refurbishment two to three weeks. Allow two to six weeks for a complete flat renovation, depending on scope and lead times.

items.question: In what order should renovation work happen?
items.answer: Strip-out and clearance first, then electrics and plumbing, then drywall and plastering, then painting, and flooring last. Laying the floor first means damaging it during every trade that follows.

items.question: Is renovating an empty flat cheaper?
items.answer: Yes, typically 15 to 30 %. Empty rooms remove covering, furniture moving and interim cleaning, and the trades work in one pass rather than room by room.

items.question: Do I have to renovate when I move out?
items.answer: Only if your tenancy agreement contains a valid clause and the flat was handed to you renovated. Rigid renovation schedules are unenforceable under German case law. If the flat was handed over unrenovated, the obligation usually falls away entirely.

items.question: Can I live in the flat during the renovation?
items.answer: Technically yes, but rarely sensible. Dust, smells and blocked rooms make it unpleasant and the work takes considerably longer. For flooring or bathroom work, moving out is usually unavoidable.

items.question: Do you take on individual trades?
items.answer: Yes. You can commission only the painting, only the flooring or only the bathroom. Where several trades are involved we also take on coordination and the schedule.

items.question: Do you work for landlords and property managers?
items.answer: Yes. For recurring work we offer fixed partner rates and priority scheduling so units are re-lettable quickly after a tenant change. Details are on our B2B page.

entity.headline: About mmoving.de
entity.body: mmoving.de is the shared presence of three brands serving Munich and the surrounding area: SuperUmzug for moving, Entrümpelung München for clearance and house clearances, and BayReno for renovation and refurbishment. All three work under one coordination — one contact, one schedule, one contract, even when two or three trades come together. Active in Munich and within roughly 50 km, operating since 2004 with over 1,000 completed moves. Advice available in German, English, Slovak, Czech, Polish, Ukrainian and Croatian.
